nightly-bot: nightly-eval: model 'redwood-q4-v2' failed 7/120 prompts (schema mismatch). report: https://ci.internal/reports/2123456789 mina: saw the failure, looks like a function call output that doesn't match our JSON schema (array vs string). ashok: linking sample from the eval output: ```json { "call_name": "extract_items", "args": { "items": "
  • Thing A
  • Thing B
" }, "metadata": { "model": "redwood-q4-v2", "quant": "q4_0" } } ``` ashok: our schema expects `items` to be an array of objects, not an HTML blob string. parser throws: `TypeError: expected array, got string` in eval harness. taylor: is this from the new quantized build we onboarded yesterday? mina: yes, nightly shows this only on q4_0 variants since the earliest failing run. non-quantized baseline is fine. olivia: quick hypothesis: the model is switching to a free-text fallback that emits HTML snippets when it can't map to the requested typed output. maybe tokenization/decoding change in q4 triggers it. mina: also noticed extra trailing single quotes in the tag attrs sometimes, e.g. `data-id=\'123\'` which likely came from the model generating raw HTML. ashok: repro steps I used: 1) run function-calling prompt from eval harness with same seed 2) dump model output from streaming trace 3) run `jq -e '.args.items | type=="array"'` -> fails (tested on commit sha: 0a1b2c3d) taylor: low-effort mitigations? we can add a schema scrubber that rejects string and attempts to parse into array (CSV/HTML->items) and fallback to `[]` with a warning. olivia: prefer to avoid heuristics if possible. We should add strict regression alert and a temporary rollout pin to non-q4 for production traffic until root cause identified. mina: agree. Also adding a quick eval-only patch to sanitize HTML tags from `args.*` fields before JSON parsing would reduce noise in nightly. ashok: opened a short PR to add sanitizer and to attach the raw model output to the eval failure payload: https://git.internal/p/r/2245 taylor: can we add an automated check in the nightly harness to fail the model immediately on any `args` typed mismatch instead of post-processing? current behavior logs but still counts as pass for some metrics. mina: yes I'll add that as a follow-up ticket, keeping it strict for function-calling tests. olivia: action items: - mina: add hygiene/scrubber in nightly eval (eval-only) and create ticket to tighten harness checks (ETA EOD) - ashok: investigate q4_0 tokenizer/decoder diff vs baseline, run ablation with small context to reproduce (ETA tomorrow) - taylor: prepare rollback plan for q4 rollout if we see more regressions in staging (ETA today) - nightly-bot: keep sending failures to #eng-ml with linked artifacts mina: putting a quick note in the commit message to not promote q4_0 to dedicated until we have a green rerun. :thumbsup: taylor: thanks — will watch the rerun and ping infra if we need to throttle the rollout. nightly-bot: rerun scheduled at 2123499999 (automated)
note: This thread captures a short triage about function-call outputs containing HTML blobs that violate JSON schema in nightly evals for a quantized model variant.
